cases.title: Development: revenue, calculation reuse and scope correction
turns: Report MSFT revenue and operating margin for 2024-10-01 through 2024-12-31 using information available by 2025-01-31. Show the operands and sources.
Explain that margin calculation using the saved sources.
Now change the question to the previous quarter. Keep the same information cutoff. State any missing evidence instead of reusing the old quarter's answer.

cases.title: Development: distinguish data and explanations
turns: Using NVIDIA disclosures available by 2025-03-01, explain why gaming revenue changed in fiscal Q4 2025. Separate reported numbers from management's explanation, with original sources.
Can that evidence establish that gaming demand will recover next quarter? Explain what can and cannot be concluded.
